tasks.gr11-bank-creditors-reconciliations-t1: Topic: Bank and Creditors Reconciliations. Cover the bank reconciliation process, outstanding deposits, unpresented cheques, cashbook errors, creditors reconciliation, and related internal controls. Ask Grade 11 learners to reconcile a bank statement, identify timing differences or errors, or explain internal control procedures that support the reconciliation process.
tasks.gr11-fixed-assets-depreciation-t1: Topic: Fixed Assets and Depreciation. Cover the fixed-asset register, the straight-line and diminishing-balance depreciation methods, recording asset disposal, and internal controls over tangible assets. Ask Grade 11 learners to calculate annual depreciation, determine carrying value, record a disposal transaction, or evaluate internal control measures for fixed assets.
tasks.gr11-partnership-concepts-adjustments-t1: Topic: Partnership Concepts and Adjustments. Cover the nature of partnerships, the partnership agreement, interest on capital, interest on drawings, salary allowances, and year-end adjustments. Ask Grade 11 learners to process adjustment journal entries, calculate partner interest amounts, or explain the importance of a written partnership agreement.
tasks.gr11-partner-accounts-final-statements-t: Topic: Partner Accounts and Final Statements. Cover the appropriation account, partner capital accounts, partner current accounts, and the preparation of final accounts. Ask Grade 11 learners to complete an appropriation account, update partner current accounts, balance the accounting equation for a partnership, or explain the difference between capital and current accounts.
